inputs.text: high quality video, sharp focus, clean render, detailed textures, cinematic lighting, professional post-production, 4k detail
blurry, low quality, distorted, glitch, artifacts, flickering, jerky motion, compression artifacts, watermark, noisy, grainy, washed out, banding

_meta.title: Load Source (frame_load_cap = exact source length, per clip)
Resize to Pass-1 Res (aspect-matched per clip)
Pass 1 Sigmas: DENOISE slider (0.55 light restyle | 0.4 polish | 0.7 more life | 1.0 full restyle)
VAE Decode @ Pass-1 Res (native, no latent upscale)
Trim to Source Length N (drops wrap frames)
Loop Anchor = source frame 0 (driver --anchor-image swaps in a still)

_metadata.assumes: the SOURCE already loops (its frame N-1 flows into frame 0)
_metadata.pipeline: DEFAULT (light_d55 recipe, locked 2026-09-23): source N + wrap 0..p-1 -> aspect-matched ~0.5MP LTX retake from the source noised by BasicScheduler denoise 0.55 -> loop pinned to the source's own frame 0 at indices 0/a/b -> native decode -> trim to N.
_metadata.loop_mechanism: All three pins are the source's own frame 0 at pass-1 res (node 45). Using the clip's own frame avoids the one-frame snap that a foreign anchor causes at denoise < ~0.95 (measured: neon anchor @0.4 = 20% frame-0->1 jump, 14% seam; source anchor @0.55 = 2.9% jump, 4.4% seam vs source 3.4%).
_metadata.frames: driver per clip: node 7 cap=N, 40 len=p, 43/44 = seam pins a/b, sampler 15 indices, 42 len=N; nodes 8/30 = aspect-matched pass-1 WxH (mult of 32, ~960x544 area)

creativity_knobs.node 11 denoise: 0.4 polish (~3-4% change) | 0.55 default light restyle (~9%) | 0.65-0.7 more life (~10-15%) | 1.0 full reinvention (use with --anchor-image)
creativity_knobs.node 5 prompt: generic by default; at cfg 1 it steers gently, describe scene + extras via --prompt for targeted looks
creativity_knobs.anchor: --anchor-image FILE pins a still instead of source frame 0: only coherent at denoise 1.0 (full restyle); at lower denoise it snaps
creativity_knobs.seed: variation within the same recipe (driver randomizes per clip)

_metadata.oom_fallbacks: n/a at 960x544 single tile (~28GB VRAM observed)
_metadata.validate_after: light_d55 reference: seam 4.44% (source 3.42%), frame0->1 2.87%, 8.8% mean change
_metadata.removed_pass2: 2026-09-23: the IC-LoRA pixel-upscaler refine at 1920x1088 rendered the dilated reference's sparse grid literally (brown background + grid of small squares) and cost ~7 min/clip. Pass 2 is gone; git history has it.
_metadata.timing: L40S 288f: ~6-8 min/clip at denoise 0.55 (BasicScheduler 16 kept steps)
_metadata.removed_latent_upscaler: 2026-09-23: decoding the LTX 2x latent upscaler output without a re-sample pass smears motion into a crosshatch texture; it must be followed by a refine pass or not used.
_metadata.creativity: Creativity = where pass 1 starts on the distilled schedule '1.0, 0.99375, 0.9875, 0.98125, 0.975, 0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875, 0.0'. Composition, colour and lighting are decided in the 1.0-0.975 steps; starting at 0.909 skips them and only redraws detail on the source (2026-09-23 diagnostics: 0.909 = 7-9% change and prompt ignored, 1.0 = 25% change and prompt fully applied).
